prompt_en: Adult woman, pretty and cute: refined face, lively eyes, glossy hair. Preserve uploaded portrait as sole identity: eyes, nose, lips, jaw, skin, hairline, adult age; no de-aging. Room-light bounce casts contact shadow; one loose hair remains. Plain unlettered bokeh.
